question.problem:
Which of the following augmented matrices are in row echelon form?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & -4 & 9 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 3\end{aligned}],\,\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 0 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 11 & 1\end{aligned}],\,\,C=[\begin{aligned}7 & 6 & 6 & 8 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & 6 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 4 & 6\end{aligned}].
$$

Which of the following augmented matrices are in row echelon form?
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14241016/assets/ca93a43bae12db0a71cfd6d0327bea50179b3b57929f1899a3d2b1f6fc43854a.svg)
current_example.worked_solution:
Remember that an augmented matrix is in row echelon form if its coefficient matrix satisfies the following conditions:

I. All the zero rows (rows with only zeros), if any, are placed at the *bottom* of the matrix.

II. Each leading entry of a row is in a column *to the right* of the leading entry of the row above it.

With that in mind, let's look at each matrix in turn.

- The first matrix is not in row echelon form since $a_{32} \neq 0$ (condition II is violated).
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14241016/assets/b7b8db1f3ce50ab4b73b469eef721485a4dd8e8428acb61e965eaade3e7a3775.svg)

- The second matrix is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied).
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14241016/assets/49f5b1c5dcf6e9d3bd2a61706d3b77607a825aea1a592dc434b71444d57e0853.svg)

- The third matrix is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied).
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14241016/assets/c77993a1acb39d5704b1904006f73064caeaba03efae8caa770c1b9b74bcd229.svg)

- The fourth matrix is not in row echelon form since, for example, the leading entry $a_{22}$ lies to the left of the leading entry $a_{13}$ (condition II is violated).
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14241016/assets/498799aeab637e6f1f80055a5f300ba39868af5f3da60cf18f002d9d979d97f9.svg)
